title: Placement Mock Test 1
description: General service-company pattern: aptitude, reasoning, verbal, technical MCQs and two coding problems. Practice it a day or two before your drive.

questions.text: A train 150 m long passes a pole in 15 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
If 20% of x equals 30% of 60, what is x?
A can finish a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. How many days do they take working together?
questions.explanation: Together they do 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6 of the job per day, so 6 days.

questions.text: What is the simple interest on ₹5,000 at 8% per year for 3 years?
The average of the first 10 natural numbers is:

questions.explanation: The differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12: 30 + 12 = 42.

questions.text: If CAT is written as DBU, how is DOG written?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves one place forward: D→E, O→P, G→H.

questions.text: A is B's brother. C is A's mother. D is C's father. How is D related to B?
questions.explanation: C is the mother of A and B, and D is C's father, so D is B's (maternal) grandfather.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out? 121, 144, 169, 196, 200
questions.explanation: All others are perfect squares (11², 12², 13², 14²); 200 is not.

questions.text: Choose the word closest in meaning to ABUNDANT.
questions.explanation: Abundant means existing in large quantities: plentiful.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Neither the manager nor the employees ____ present at the meeting.
questions.explanation: With neither…nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, 'employees', which is plural.

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to TRANSPARENT.
questions.explanation: Transparent lets light through; opaque does not.

questions.text:
What does this pseudo-code print?

set x = 5, y = 10
x = x + y
y = x - y
x = x - y
print x, y
questions.explanation: x = 15, then y = 15 - 10 = 5, then x = 15 - 5 = 10. The values are swapped: 10 5.

questions.text:
What does this pseudo-code print?

integer a = 7
for i from 1 to 3
    a = a * 2 - i
end for
print a
What is the worst-case time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements?
questions.explanation: Each step halves the search range, so it takes about log₂ n steps.

questions.text: Which data structure works on the First-In-First-Out (FIFO) principle?
questions.explanation: A queue removes elements in the order they were added.

questions.text: Which protocol is used to browse websites securely?
questions.explanation: HTTPS is HTTP encrypted with TLS.

questions.title: Second largest distinct number
questions.text:
Given n integers, print the second largest DISTINCT value. If it does not exist, print -1.

Input: first line n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5); second line n integers, each between -10^9 and 10^9.
Output: the second largest distinct value, or -1.

Example: for 3 1 4 4 2 the distinct values are 1, 2, 3, 4, so the answer is 3.

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0])
nums = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
# write your code here

questions.explanation: Track the largest and second largest values while skipping duplicates of the largest; print -1 if the second was never set.
